what_happened: C15 (check-module-invariants.sh) requires every def:/thm:/lem:/cor:/app:/rmk: anchor cited in FormalSystem/**/*.lean to resolve against docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md (MANIFEST or KNOWN-ANCHORS row). def:flow, def:state-set and lem:state-set have NO row in either block, so the dispatch's required docstring citations will fail C15 until three KNOWN-ANCHORS LIVE-UNPINNED rows are added. That record file is in concurrent sibling task 756's declared file_scope this same cycle, so the edit must be re-read-immediately-before and staged line-scoped.

All four deliverable declarations (StateOccurs.of_isRegular plus the three [F.IsRegular]-only corollaries) compiled on the first lean_run_code attempt with zero new imports: FormalSystem.Semantics.Extension.Extension is already in StateSetTruth.lean's transitive import closure via Semantics.Validity. Axiom profiles came out exactly as the dispatch predicted ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for the new forms; the originals unchanged at [propext] and [propext, Quot.sound]).

Plan-time re-probe of the four Challenge statements via lean_run_code failed with 'Imports are out of date and must be rebuilt'. Cause: concurrent sibling task 789 holds uncommitted edits to FormalSystem/Semantics/PartialHistory.lean and FormalSystem/Semantics/Presheaf/{Behavior,Determinism,Directed,Ray,Sheaf}.lean, all inside StateSetTruth.lean's import closure, so the olean cache is stale. The four signatures are therefore carried from the research report's compiled probe rather than re-derived at plan time; the plan records this as a Scope Hypothesis for Phase 2/3 to confirm.

Sibling task 789 has an uncommitted modification to FormalSystem/Semantics/Presheaf/Determinism.lean, which is NOT in its declared file_scope for this cycle (its declared Presheaf entries are Behavior/Directed/Ray/Sheaf/README only). Reported rather than treated as a stop condition: the file is outside task 792's own two-file Lean scope, the writer is an announced concurrent sibling, and git log confirms no foreign commit.

The research report's headline territory risk (docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md held by concurrent sibling task 756) has cleared: task 756 reached status 'completed' and the record file is clean in git. The C15 unblock in Phase 1 therefore needs no dependency edge and no serialization.

Running plan-file-scope-harvest.sh against the draft plan caught three forced generated surfaces the research report and the first plan draft both missed: check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory rewrites the Independence/ subdir totals row in FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md and the dir=FormalSystem totals row in README.md, and the harvester unconditionally appends typst/generated/status.typ for any .lean-touching plan. Two of the three sit in concurrent sibling task 789's declared file_scope. The plan was corrected to declare them, narrow the blanket 'no sibling-scope files' Non-Goal, and add two territory risk rows with a re-read-and-STOP mitigation.

Two gates the research report did not reach were checked at plan time and are both clear, saving the implementer a discovery cycle: C35 (lean-citation-manifest.json byte-currency by declaration span) is unaffected because neither scripts/lean-citation-seeds.txt nor the manifest mentions StateSetTruth, OrderTransfer, satSet or any of the three original theorem names; C20's third assertion is unaffected because a repo-wide sweep outside specs/** finds zero StateSetTruth.lean:NNN or OrderTransfer.lean:NNN citations. C34b's trigger was also read off the source: it is line-scoped and its seven constraint tokens are case-sensitive, so the mitigation is exact rather than approximate.

check-paper-definitions.sh exits 1 on a PRE-EXISTING drift wave of 10 recorded MANIFEST anchors (CO, def:BX, def:BX-z, def:BX-d, def:TMplus, app:discrete, def:id, def:strongest, thm:exist, lem:uniq), none of them this task's five. Phase 1 adds five pointer-only LIVE-UNPINNED KNOWN-ANCHORS rows and zero sha256 lines, so it cannot have introduced drift; the plan's 'check-paper-definitions.sh exits 0' criterion was unachievable at dispatch time. Proceeded, recording the red gate as inherited rather than absorbing the drift wave (out of this task's scope).

Plan Phases 2-4 each require 'check-module-invariants.sh --no-build exits 0', but the first .lean line-count change makes the INV generated-inventory group stale, and the plan assigns inventory regeneration to Phase 5 alone. The criterion is therefore unsatisfiable mid-sequence by construction. Resolved by reading the per-check verdicts the phases actually name (C15, C34a, C34b, C9, C20, C33 all PASS) and deferring whole-script exit 0 to Phase 5 after --emit-inventory, rather than regenerating shared README surfaces early against the plan's own collision mitigation.

The typst-sync-check pre-commit gate BLOCKED the Phase 2 commit: formalsystem-line-count committed=355156 vs live=355171, moved by this phase's 15 added lines. The plan's Phase 5 explicitly hypothesised typst/generated/status.typ would be byte-identical because the task 'adds no axiom, no rule, no sorry and no version-pin change' -- but the gate keys on the whole-tree LINE COUNT, which any .lean addition moves, so that hypothesis was wrong and the collision lands at the FIRST .lean commit (Phase 2), not at Phase 5. Resolved per the gate's own remedy: bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix, then stage typst/generated/status.typ alongside the .lean file. No --no-verify bypass used. Cost: one blocked commit plus a regeneration per .lean-touching phase.

All four new declarations elaborated first try, with the exact proof terms and the exact axiom profiles the plan's carried Challenge signatures predicted (four at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], the two originals unchanged at [propext] and [propext, Quot.sound]). The plan's decision to CARRY the research report's compiled lean_run_code probes rather than re-derive them under a stale import closure paid off exactly: zero proof search, zero lean_multi_attempt rounds, three scoped builds green on first invocation. Phases 2-4 took well under their 1.75h combined estimate.
